Netflix & Disney Reportedly Offered $20 MILLION For A Nipsey Hussle Documentary, But His Family Turned Them Down To Release It INDEPENDENTLY💰👀 🏁💙🕊️

Nipsey Hussle, Born Ermias Joseph Asghedom, Was A Legendary Los Angeles Rapper, Entrepreneur, And Community Activist Who Became One Of The Most Respected Figures In West Coast Hip-Hop. Raised In The Crenshaw District Of South Los Angeles, Nipsey Built His Career Independently Through Mixtapes Like The Marathon, Crenshaw, And Mailbox Money. His Debut Studio Album, Victory Lap, Released In 2018, Earned A Grammy Nomination And Featured Collaborations With Artists Like Kendrick Lamar, YG, And Diddy.

Beyond Music, Nipsey Was Known For His Dedication To Giving Back To His Community. He Founded The Marathon Clothing Store, Invested In Local Businesses, And Created Opportunities For Young People In South Los Angeles. Sadly, Nipsey Passed Away On March 31, 2019, At Just 33 Years Old After Being Sh*t Outside His Marathon Clothing Store. His Legacy Continues To Inspire Millions Through His Music, Business Mindset, And Powerful Message Of Ownership, Independence, And Community Empowerment. 🏁💙🕊️ The Marathon Continues.
